summaries.n-anthropic-ipo: Coins named for Anthropic's planned stock listing. Anthropic (ANT, Pump.fun): "$ANT The Meme Stock for the Anthropic IPO". Anthropic (ANT, StonkFun): "The Anthropic Ant." Anthropic (ANTS, Pump.fun): "As Anthropic eyes Wall Street, Ant Group dons a suit." Three more coins named Anthropic (Clanker V4: one on Base, 0x191d77..., and two on Robinhood Chain, 0xf289e2... and 0x11188a...) have no description; their name is the story. Dates from Codex: the ANT pool on StonkFun opened 2026-09-11, the ANT pool on Pump.fun 2026-10-19 and the ANTS pool on Pump.fun 2026-10-31 (after the filing); the Robinhood Chain pool 0xf289e2... opened on 2026-11-04, the Base pool 0x191d77... on 2026-11-05 at 13:59 UTC and the Robinhood Chain pool 0x11188a... on 2026-11-05 at 14:35 UTC, all after it. The descriptions are the coins' own; none of the coins is shown to be connected to Anthropic. Archived (under $1,000 of volume two days running): the Robinhood Chain coin 0xcee339..., the Base coin 0xfff156... and the first Base coin (0xf7b9cf...).

n-anthropic-ipo.notice: Posts of 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06 say Anthropic made its S-1 public on 2026-10-26 and intends to list on Nasdaq under ANT. Posts of 2026-11-06 06:14 to 06:58 UTC cite the Wall Street Journal for an annualized revenue run rate above $80 billion at the end of October, an IPO raise that could shrink to about $80 billion from up to $100 billion, a possible delay, and doubts that it can list at a $1.5 trillion valuation; one post says the odds of an IPO by year-end fell 25% in 24 hours and another calls a report that the IPO was cancelled unreliable. Reports in posts, not verified here.
